name: guard-push0-undefined-at-berlin
rationale: EIP-3855 regression guard. 0x5f must remain an undefined opcode at Berlin: the frame that executes it aborts, so the caller records slot0=1 (the call failed) and callee A's storage stays empty. Callee B runs the same program with PUSH1 0x00 in place of PUSH0 and always succeeds, so slot1=1 is a positive precondition: a candidate that simply broke CALL could not pass this case either. At Shanghai the same inputs give slot0 absent and A.storage[0]=1.
source: synthetic (step 04 reviser, round 1) -- regression guard for a Shanghai behaviour that instruction.md forbids leaking backwards
